      Akash Tyagi

      Akash Tyagi

      Talent Acquisition at Baazi Games

      We're looking for someone who:

      • Has 4–8 years of experience in Manual Testing and Game Testing.
      • Has hands-on experience testing mobile and/or web games.
      • Is skilled at creating test scenarios, executing test cases, and identifying critical issues.
      • Has experience with defect tracking and ensuring high-quality releases.
      • Understands SDLC, STLC, Agile methodologies, and QA best practices.
      • Enjoys collaborating with developers, designers, and product teams to deliver the best player experience.


      • Seniority level

        Mid-Senior level

      • Employment type

        Full-time

      • Industries

        Technology, Information and Internet, Technology, Information and Media, and Computer Games
